propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs an AcliClient without validating that JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN are non-empty, resulting in anonymous credentials and late failure on first API call instead of early construction-time detection.

Cloud adapter lacks the fail-fast construction-time credential guard present in the DC adapter, creating a test-parity gap where DC raises loudly on missing JIRA_PAT but Cloud silently builds a doomed backend.

The presence-and-format guard must validate each of JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN for emptiness/whitespace and require JIRA_USER to contain an @ symbol with non-empty local and domain parts (email format check).

Two existing tests must be updated: test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly must flip from absence-doc to assert BackendEnvError; test_the_cloud_factory_also_asserts_conformance must use a valid email in its monkeypatched settings so it passes the credential guard and still reaches the conformance assertion.
